Association coefficients of a two-latent-variable model

Source: R/joint_classes.R
joint_coefficients.Rd

The multinomial logit of y on x from fit_joint_classes(), in the reference-class form: every log-odds is against the last y class, and x enters as indicators against the last x class. Rows are the intercept (term = "Intercept", the log-odds among the last x class), the x effects (term = "X#k"), and each covariate on y: one row for a common slope, or, for a covariate acting by x class, its slope in the last x class (x = NA) and the difference from it in each other class.

Usage

joint_coefficients(fit)

Arguments

fit

A joint_classes fit.

Value

A data frame with columns y, term, x, estimate, se, z, p. Each row is also a parameter of wald_test() and derived_estimates(), under the label "Y#j Intercept", "Y#j ON X#k", "Y#j ON x" or, for the difference of a covariate's slope in x class k from the last class's, "Y#j ON x | X#k".
